pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid beside Bremen’s main railway station and long-distance bus terminal, with private family rooms and a shared guest kitchen.

Family and budget stay

Book a whole private family room and confirm beds, occupancy and cot needs. Dormitory beds are separate products. The communal guest kitchen, game zone and shared lounge offer useful facilities between outings; check equipment, storage and house rules.

The railway and bus terminals are nearby. Plan walking or public-transport routes to the old town, especially with children or luggage. Compare the complete private-room cost, taxes, breakfast, nearby parking, luggage storage and cancellation terms for the actual dates.

Guest feedback

Guests praise transport access, cleanliness and value. Accounts also describe ventilation noise, varied staff responses and service concerns. These are guest reports; ask about room position and ventilation if noise matters. The rubric is a snapshot drawn from a small review sample, rather than a live rating.

Opening and development

The hotel opened on 25 May 2022, as explicitly reported by Hospitality ON alongside the operator’s announced date. The formal opening is distinguished from earlier construction plans.

MEININGER’s launch release describes 126 rooms and 378 beds within the completed HIGHeleven development. These are opening-era figures, separate from later directory counts. No hotel-specific construction budget was verified; costs for the broader bus-terminal, parking and office development are not assigned to this hotel.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor UK refreshed snapshot 24 reviews, overall 3.8/5. Rooms 4.1, Service 4.4, Location 4.8, Cleanliness 4.8, Value 4.2, rounded to half steps; small sample explicit. Chris S. firsthand review displayed August 2026 about February 2026 stay, site-translated from German; no exact publication day, date null. Ventilation and service tradeoffs retained as guest accounts. MICHELIN complete Bremen list 1–5 of 5 has no MEININGER match; Forbes Bremen unavailable; AAA excludes Germany. Acclaim null due guide gap.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family resort in Manteca, Northern California, with suites, an indoor water park included with overnight stays, and additional paid attractions.

Family water-park stay

Choose the exact suite layout, beds and booked occupancy; standard, themed and larger suites have different limits. Overnight water-park access and daily family activities are included. Check hours, height restrictions, wristbands, supervision and arrival-day or departure-day admission terms.

Adventure Park attractions, arcade play, dining, parking and other extras can add to the bill. Compare the complete stay price and package terms for your dates. This is the Manteca property in the Central Valley; allow for actual travel distances from Bay Area cities.

Guest feedback

Families describe children enjoying the water park. Accounts also raise crowding, delayed room readiness, cleaning and maintenance, noise and extra-cost concerns. These are guest reports, rather than independently established faults. Read recent suite-specific feedback and plan around actual operating hours. Scores are a dated snapshot.

Formal opening and investment

The operator’s printed 29 June 2021 release marks the formal grand opening and reports 500 rooms, a 95,000-square-foot indoor water park and a 45,000-square-foot Adventure Park. These are opening-era capacities. The PDF filename’s earlier date is not used as the event date.

Earlier soft-opening operations are separate from the formal event.

Contemporary Manteca Bulletin reporting describes the completed resort as a US$180 million project. This reported whole-resort investment is saved separately from nightly rates. It is not a current room quote or the cost of only the indoor water park.

Crowding, room readiness, cleanliness, maintenance, noise and extras concerns retained as guest feedback. MICHELIN Manteca and Forbes Manteca unavailable; AAA Manteca returned a generic shell without property results or Diamond evidence. Acclaim null.
